verbalization: Oblonganoside C appears to exert its biological effects through a shared target, Dual specificity protein kinase CLK2, via two distinct but interconnected pathways. The first pathway links Oblonganoside C to Serine/threonine-protein kinase SBK1, which is targeted by benzocaine, and subsequently targets CLK2. The second pathway connects Oblonganoside C to Caov-4, which is targeted by K-252a, also targeting CLK2. Both pathways converge on CLK2, suggesting that Oblonganoside C may modulate CLK2 through different upstream regulators. The scores from the two paths indicate a moderate level of confidence in the relationship, with slight variations in confidence scores. The mechanism involves the inhibition of CLK2 through the activation of downstream signaling pathways, potentially through the modulation of its substrate targets. The integration of these pathways highlights the complexity of the signaling network and underscores the importance of understanding the interplay between these molecular interactions.
